_comment: Shared TS/Python fixture for sub-agent time budgets. Each case creates a root scope with root_budget at the wall-clock instant `start` (epoch seconds), then runs `steps` in order: at start + `at`, attenuate the most recently granted scope (the root at first) with time_budget_seconds (null: omitted). A granted step becomes the scope the next step attenuates; a refused or expired step does not. `refused` is AttenuationDenied with these violations and exactly this reason; `expired` is ScopeTokenError with code `expired`.

steps.reason: time_budget_seconds exceeds the parent's remaining time; at most 7 seconds are available

cases.name: 2.9 seconds left means 2 seconds are available

steps.reason: time_budget_seconds exceeds the parent's remaining time; at most 2 seconds are available
